### AI Agents for Physics / MCP for Science

| arXiv ID | Title | Relevance |
|---|---|---|
| **2611.08583** | DarkMatterFM-Registry: A Machine-Readable Registry of Dark-Matter Models Extracted from the arXiv Literature (Zelko, Bovy, Koblischke; NeurIPS ML4PS 2026) | **Directly relevant meta-tool.** LLM pipeline extracts 6,145 structured DM-model cards from arXiv full texts (97.8% schema-valid, 81% LLM-judged-correct, 0% hallucinated in audit sample), enriches ~2,000 with observables/constraints/theory-to-observable routes, and derives a priority-weighted roadmap of 25 community infrastructure gaps. **Their top finding: the bottleneck for most high-priority DM models is missing shared infrastructure — general relic-abundance solvers, a non-cold Boltzmann-code framework, reusable indirect-detection likelihoods, a non-cold-DM Lyman-α likelihood — not missing theory.** This is close to a direct validation of our own MCP-server strategy (wrapping existing solvers as reusable, composable tools) and the registry itself (released at ioanazelko.github.io/darkmatterfm-registry) could be mined as a structured source of DM-model definitions for our `lz-dark-sector-bridge` / `inelastic-dm-server` tool docs. Worth reaching out or at minimum citing. |
